bio: Serafina Moretti has risen remarkably within Venice's facchini class, transforming from a humble porter to a prosperous merchant dealing in textiles and small goods through her merceria. Born to a family of dockworkers from Cannaregio, Serafina's shrewd business acumen and tireless work ethic enabled her to amass substantial wealth (139,747 ducats) beyond what most of her social class could imagine.
